يحتبسوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَبِسُوا (yaḥtabisū) /jaħ.ta.bi.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# يُحْتَبَسُوا (yuḥtabasū) /juħ.ta.ba.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
